title: Quotient tensor chain map from a semilinear comparison
statement: Let R and A be commutative rings, f:R→A a ring homomorphism, I an ideal of R, and J=map(f,I). Let M be an R-module and N an A-module, and let P→M and G→N be projective resolutions (projective terms [def-weil-pbc-projective-module] and exact augmented complexes [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence], with cycles as in [def-weil-pbc-module-chain-complex-homology]). Suppose additive maps φ_n:P_n→G_n satisfy φ_n(rp)=f(r)φ_n(p) and d_G φ_{n+1}=φ_n d_P. There is a morphism ψ of underlying additive complexes P⊗_R R/I→G⊗_A A/J such that ψ_n(p⊗mk_I(r))=φ_n(p)⊗mk_J(f(r)). For every degree-one cycle z of the source there is a degree-one cycle w of the target with ψ_1(iCycles(z))=iCycles(w). Neither augmentations, freeness of the terms, Tor, nor any connecting maps are needed.

source.place: Parent lem-weil-pbc-tor-ideal-comparison-compatibility, Step 1; Algebra, Section 00LY, proof of 00M5 and Remark 00M6. The quotient-complex details are expanded explicitly here.

proof.text: Since f(I)⊆J, descend mk_J∘f through R/I using Ideal.Quotient.lift. Its scalar formula on representatives makes it an f-semilinear map qL:R/I→A/J. Package each φ_n as an f-semilinear map φL_n.

Use TensorProduct.map φL_n qL and forget scalar structures to define ψ_n. For a consecutive differential, tensor induction reduces the chain identity to hdφ on p⊗r. HomologicalComplex.Hom needs only pairs related by the complex shape; these are exactly i=j+1. This constructs ψ and proves its pure tensor formula.

For z a cycle, let x=ψ_1(iCycles(z)). The chain identity and iCycles_d give d_G x=0. The A-linear map A→(G⊗A/J)_1 sending a to a•x has zero composite with d. Lift this map to cycles via HomologicalComplex.liftCycles, and evaluate at 1 to obtain w. The liftCycles_i identity gives iCycles(w)=x.

theorem exists_quotient_tensor_comparison
    {R A : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing A]
    (f : R →+* A) (I : Ideal R) (J : Ideal A) (hJ : J = Ideal.map f I)
    (M : ModuleCat.{u} R) (N : ModuleCat.{u} A)
    (P : ProjectiveResolution M) (G : ProjectiveResolution N)
    (φ : ∀ n : ℕ, (P.complex.X n) →+ (G.complex.X n))
    (hφ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : R) (p : P.complex.X n), φ n (r • p) = f r • φ n p)
    (hdφ : ∀ (n : ℕ) (p : P.complex.X (n + 1)),
      G.complex.d (n + 1) n (φ (n + 1) p) = φ n (P.complex.d (n + 1) n p)) :
    ∃ ψ : ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} R) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex) ⟶
      ((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} A) AddCommGrpCat).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj G.complex),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (p : P.complex.X n) (r : R),
        ψ.f n (p ⊗ₜ[R] Ideal.Quotient.mk I r) =
          φ n p ⊗ₜ[A] Ideal.Quotient.mk J (f r)) ∧
      (∀ z : ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).cycles 1,
        ∃ w : ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj G.complex).cycles 1,
          ψ.f 1 (((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} R)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj P.complex).iCycles 1 z) =
            ((((tensoringRight (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ J))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (ComplexShape.down ℕ)).obj G.complex).iCycles 1 w)
